name: Yandere-Chan
source:
In this short story, you assume the role of a new transfer student that catches the attention of a strange reclusive girl, who claims to have met you at some point in the past. You don't know where or when you allegedly met her, and in time you may end up wishing you never met her at all...because she is literally crazy for you! In the typical yandere themed visual novel, the number of bad ends you can reach will far outweigh the good ones. However, in this game there is ONLY one good end. 

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/yandere.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
在这部短篇故事中，你扮演一名转学生，引起了一个奇怪的孤僻女孩的注意，她声称在过去某个时候见过你。你不知道据说在哪里或什么时候见过她，而随着时间的推移，你可能会希望自己根本没有见过她……因为她真的为你疯狂！在典型的病娇主题视觉小说中，坏结局的数量远远超过好结局。然而在这款游戏中，只有一个好结局。

[来自[url=http://renai.us/game/yandere.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
